title: its ok. will buy queen/king next time
text:
its ok. will buy queen/king next time. This blanket is for sure "full/queen" with emphasis on full. It is wide enough... But to short! I cannot tuck it under the mattress at all.
There is no satin binding to indicate the top/ bottom for ease of placing on the bed. Its basically a large piece of fabric with a hem all the way around.
For the price... Not what I had hoped for.
The weight of the material is good as I was searching for a summer weight blanket. I will read the description closer next time I buy a blanket.
